items.text: Kodelo ekodet kere; komonya ituŋa akuare nin,
Kirurumata idwe luka Isirael kere aluikin Musa ka Aaron da: kobala ekodet kere kes ebe, “Tiejok arai katwakikinito akwap nako Misiri! Tiejok da arai katwakikinito amodiŋ na!
Kanukinyo kiyaunia EJAKAIT sio akwap na, adanyio kekileŋ? Anorokosi ka ikosidwe ludidik da araun lumejan: mam tiejok sio aboŋor Misiri?”
Kotemanaros bonik atiar, “Kaseutu ekenarenon, kabonosi Misiri.”
Kosodi Musa ka Aaron aibirokin kwap ebuburia, kakonyen nuka ekodet kere loka idwe luka Isirael.
Apotu Yosua okoku loka Nun ka Kaleb okoku loka Yepune luaraas iarei kanul kaluarosito akwap, koeilieilata ikeeenapen:
Kolimokis ekodet kere loka idwe luka Isirael ebe, “Akwap, nakitor kirosi, erai akwap naitelekarit kajokis,
Arai kisiyalamikinit oni EJAKAIT, kiyai ŋesi oni akwap nin, kainakini oni da; akwap naeleleete akile ka esik.
Konye sirikipaliikis EJAKAIT, karaida aiyoŋ ituŋa luka akwap; naarai eraas atapawok; alemar etorubekec kamakee, ejai EJAKAIT nepepe kaoni: sirikiyoŋa kes.”
Konye akoto ekodet kere aibiribir kes kamor.
Kosodi aibuses naka EJAKAIT aitakanikin idwe kere luka Isirael kowema loka airiamunun.
Kotema EJAKAIT Musa atiar, “Itodolete ai iruna lu kamwanitos eoŋ? Itodolete da ai mam keyuunitos, kanuka aanyuneta kere nueswamak kes?
Adanyi kes katular, ademari kes airumet, etuluori jo ateker naepol naegogon adepar kes.”
Kotema Musa EJAKAIT atiar, “Aso epupunete Imisirian nun: naarai ijo iyauni ituŋa lu kotoma apedorikon kamakee;

Elimokinete da luibojete kakwap kaŋin: apuput ebe ijai ijo EJAKAIT kidin kituna kalu: naarai kianyununo jo EJAKAIT kakonyen, ebwoi da ekonidou kamakee, iŋarenikinit kes, kepir loka edou paaran, ka epir loka akim kuare.
Aso arai kiara ijo ituŋa lu adaun cut, etemarete atekerin nuapuputu eemutukon atiar.
‘Kanu naarai mam EJAKAIT abu kopedo ayaun ituŋa nul toma akwap naabu kiyapoik kes, ŋes aarakinia kes amodiŋ.’
Aso kenaiŋait, kopoloor apedor naka EJAKAIT kwape ejaatar nuibu ijo kiner ebe,

‘Iyapi EJAKAIT anyunyurikin, ileleba aitim, isioniei numam adolit ka aibucareta, lomam imarakini luegwaunito akirot araun ikadolitok; idopei kodwe numam adolit nuka lukapapakee, aitodol atur nakiwuniet ka nakiwononet.’
Kenainait, kisioni numam adolit nuka ituŋa kalu kwape eiaar akoniitim naepol, kwape ibu kisionio ituŋa lu, anyoun koMisiri aitodol kwana.”
Kotema EJAKAIT atiar, “Esioni kwape ejaar akonikirot:
Konye abeit, kwape ajaria, ido kwape ilelebunor akwap kere aibuses naka EJAKAIT;
Naarai ituŋa nul kere luaanyutu akaibuses, ka aanyunetaka da, nuabu keswama koMisiri, kamodiŋ da, konye kakodokodata eoŋ irwan nu atomon, komam epupete ekaporoto;
Abeit mam eanyunete cut akwap naabu keyapoik lukapapaakee, karaida yenabu kamwan eoŋ kere mam eanyuni.
Konye Kaleb ekakejaanakinan, naarai ajaas kemoyo ece, ido karima eoŋ cut, ayai eoŋ ŋes akwap naabu ŋesi kolosite; aurike da irumi ŋes.
Iboiete Emalekait ka Ekanaanit kaditot: kibelokinos moi, koloto amodiŋ korot loebei Aŋolol Nakarenan.’
Kotema EJAKAIT Musa ka Aaron atiar,
“Etodoli ai atitinikinit ekodet lo lokaronon, lokerurumakinit eoŋ? Apup airuruma naka idwe luka Isirael, nakerurumakinitotor eoŋ.
Kolimok kes ebe, Inera EJAKAIT atiar, Kwape ajaria, abeit kwape kilimokiniata akika, kwape kwaŋin da keswamakiniata:
Edoenenete atesinakus amodiŋ na; kere da luaponi kimarai kayesi, kwape ajaar etiaikus kere, ageun kaluka ikar akaisaarei ka luedeparito, lukerurumakis eoŋ.
Abeit mam ilomarete akwap, naabu eoŋ kario akakan ebe kesiboikini yes toma, dimarai Kaleb okoku loka Yepune ka Yosua okoku loka Nun.
Konye idwekus ludidik luibalasi yesi ebe eraunos lumeian, kes etolomari eoŋ, ido kes ejenunete akwap nainero yesi.
Konye yes, edoenenete akusitesin amodiŋ na.
Idwekus da eraunos ikerimok kotoma amodiŋ ikar akaisaoŋon, ibwokete eporokus, aitodol naedaikinotor atesinakus amodiŋ,
Kwape ejaar etiai loka apaarasia nuirosiata yes akwap, kes apaarasia akaisaoŋon, kanuka ninipaaran ekaru, ibwokiata numam adolitekus, kes ikar akaisaon on, ijenunete da apalunika,
Ener eoŋ EJAKAIT, abeit eswamakini eoŋ ŋun ekodet lo kere lokaronon, loetukokina nepepe asurokin eoŋ: amodiŋ na ŋes edaikinos, ido nen etwakikinete.”
Ka ituŋa da, luejukarit Musa airot akwap, luabonunete, kosodete aisirurumakin ŋes ekodet kere, kanuka ainun akiro nueroko aitoronia akwap,
Ituŋa nupenul luayaunete akiro nueroko aitoronia akwap, kotwaka atular kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT.
Konye Yosua okoku loka Nun, ka Kaleb okoku loka Yepune, kes apotu kojarata koruna lualosito airot akwap.
Kolimok Musa idwe kere luka Isirael akiro ŋun: kibworoto ituŋa noi.
Kodilokis anyoun tupuruc, kodokasi kuiu oroŋat, kobalas ebe, “Koany, isio lu, kidokari do aibois nakisumunit EJAKAIT: naarai kidiaka.”
Kotema Musa atiar, “Kanukinyo ipaariata kaieorakinet naka EJAKAIT, naarai emamuun asuliany?
Sirikidokasi, naarai mam EJAKAIT ejai kidiŋikus; kinyeis adanyio kakonyen nuka lukasurupokus,
Naarai ejaas nina kiŋarenikus Emalekait ka Ekanaanit, kidanyio kekilen: naarai ibonut katupit EJAKAIT, kanuka ŋun mam EJAKAIT ejaun kayes.”
Konye konasikinos adokar kuiu oroŋat: kwabo mam asaduku naka aitutuket naka EJAKAIT, ka Musa, apotu konyout koidukurun.
Kosodete Emalekait ka Ekanaanit lueboienenete koroŋat kanol aijesun, kodanya kes, kibirut kes, aitodol Koruma.
